description: This file defines the Reward controller class for the OpenCart admin extension, handling the display and save operations for reward total settings within the admin panel.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for managing reward total settings in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the reward total configuration page, setting up the view data including breadcrumbs, config values, and header/footer components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of reward total settings, including permission check and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
